types.label: value.status
types.note: An exec job's lifecycle as a fact (ADR-0026 Inc B): pending → done | error. A lean observability projection of the authoritative job — poll @c15r/run.fetch for the full result. Keyed run-job/<jobId>; makes runs queryable (query type=run-job), linkable, and salient.

schema.jobId: string — the job id (also the fetch handle)
schema.at: string — ISO timestamp of this transition
schema.codeBytes: number? — size of the submitted code
schema.emitted: string[]? — substrate keys the run wrote via parc.emit
